results.notes: Operating: 16 Easton Ave, Mon-Fri 10-9, Sat 10-6, Sun closed; authorized Aveda partner, established 1995. Confirmed live: zero tel: links and zero forms on the home page (phone and email are plain text on /contact), LocalBusiness JSON-LD present, robots.txt allows all with a sitemap, and the Phorest link resolves to a working 'Make an Appointment' page carrying the salon's address, phone and cancellation policy. At 390px the home page is a hamburger plus 'MODA / EST. 1995, NEW BRUNSWICK, NJ' with no services, phone or booking button above the fold. Prices, the 3.0% card surcharge and the 50% late-cancellation charge are confirmed on the contact page. Because the Color page is real, that opportunity shrinks to adding a booking CTA; gap 3 stands, ease drops 5->4 and evidence 3 because one listing source was misread. The Fresha opportunity (listing with no reviews) could not be verified.

results.name: Viola Barry F, DDS (Dr. Barry Viola)

wrong_claims.claim: Status operating; open six days a week including Saturday mornings; walk-in and referral patients

No site, hours or appointment evidence exists anywhere I could open.

results.notes: Identity confirmed, operating status not. The federal NPI registry API (opened directly) returns 149 Livingston Avenue, New Brunswick 08901, (732) 846-2643, Dentist, NJ licence 22DI01475400, status 'A'. The record's Google 4.0 from 8 reviews is corroborated by a search summary of DentistsRanked, though that page returned HTTP 429. DentistsRanked, WebMD, YellowPages and npiprofile all blocked direct fetches and Maps was not readable. Recommendation: hold this record until the owner confirms the practice is open and licensed - pitching a practice whose licence may have lapsed is a credibility risk. Evidence lowered 3->2; the other scores are plausible but moot until status is settled.

results.name: Genie Tree Service

wrong_claims.what_is_true: The New Jersey Board of Tree Experts business directory lists 'Genie Tree Service, LLC' with LTCO Eugenio Amador, registration 768400, New Brunswick NJ, phone 732-207-2067, status 'Suspended'. Under NJ rules a suspended registration bars advertising and performing tree care for hire, so the record's status field is wrong and the business cannot safely be sold to as operating. (Suspension is a licensing status, not proof the crew has stopped working.)

results.notes: Verdict is driven by the status field, not by the website analysis, which holds: no site, phone-only intake, and bestprosintown's hours blurb confirmed (Mon-Sat 8 AM-7 PM, credit cards, 'fast estimates'). The domain listed on its Google profile, genietreeservicesllc.com, still fails DNS resolution - fetching it returns getaddrinfo EAI_AGAIN, so the Maps 'Website' button is dead; the registry phone 732-207-2067 matches the record, confirming it is the same business. Recommend pulling this record from the ranked list or holding it until the registration is reinstated: there is no point pitching a site rebuild to a business that cannot legally quote work. Google's 5.0 rating and the 'Add missing information' prompts could not be re-verified because Maps was not readable here.

data_gaps: Google Maps / Business Profile pages could not be opened in this environment; ratings, review counts, photo counts, categories and 'Book online' buttons were only cross-checked through third-party directories or sites' own embedded Google widgets.

doctor.webmd.com is behind Cloudflare, dentistsranked.com returned HTTP 429, and yellowpages.com / angi.com / npiprofile.com returned HTTP 403, so the reported 2025 expiry of Dr. Viola's NJ dental licence and Angi's review counts could not be inspected first-hand.
Moda's Fresha listing (the record's third opportunity) could not be located or verified.
barbienailsnj.com's Vagaro booking backend sits behind an Imperva wall from this network, so it is unknown whether the customer-facing calendar actually loads.
Genie Tree Service's Google rating and profile prompts, and Nieto Landscaping's Google rating, rest on search-result summaries rather than pages opened directly.
